export_metadata.engine: V4 production targets + RSI(10) exit (F159 C3_hysteresis): while V4 holds TQQQ, a TQQQ RSI(10) close > 79 moves the TQQQ weight to the cash sleeve until RSI(10) closes < 70; V4 exits take precedence; decide at close t, execute at close t+1
export_metadata.data_source: the pipeline that writes backtest_data_v4.json: stock-wizard-Fed-Dualgate scripts/export_backtest_dashboard.py (algo13_v4_master, modern window: QQQ/TQQQ/SHV/VXN price cache with polygon/yfinance tail, FRED HY OAS, safe-haven proxies; production emitter and rules from stock-wizard-live-trader)
export_metadata.research_panel_note: every return in this file (2016 onward, including all returns after 2026-04-20) comes from the V4 production-pipeline prices, not the F59 research panel (which ends 2026-04-20 and fed export v1)
export_metadata.rule_asset_mapping: the rule's SGOV leg is this pipeline's cash sleeve SHV (the V4 file's cash asset); TREASURY_PROXY/GOLD_PROXY are the module's TLT/GLD columns
export_metadata.cost_model: 5 bps on buys (V4 dashboard exporter phase2._simulate_variant; weights on t applied to returns on t+1)
export_metadata.kpi_method: V4 dashboard exporter _compute_dashboard_metrics over date_range (same as backtest_data_v4)
export_metadata.v4_value_note: v4_value = V4 from the same pipeline run, same costs (comparison series)
